comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
For the Europe regions, it appears to be just what the Japanese wiki says:
- goods that were 50K-ish base, are now 38K-ish
- goods that used to be 60K-ish are now 43K-ish
It's not much of a nerf in my opinion - with a hold full of good stuff you can still easily hit the 100M.

Unfortunately, what's got painfully affected, is the short-range trade.
Goods, which are still listed here as sold for 15K-ish in SEA, are now 6K-ish.
Stuff that was selling for 35K base in India, now is barely half of that. And it looks similar for the stuff previously sold for 40K, in West America or so.
I used to be making lazy runs to India, cashing 80M each time. And now what - 30M with some change.
Whorrible stuff.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You can't hope to please everybody all the time. You'll only go mad trying. OGP is doing a pretty good job so far; they're not perfect, but I doubt that Netmarble's staff emerged fully formed ala Venus from the ocean -- I would expect that they learned and grew over time, becoming the folks who we (mostly) recall with fondness.

Are there problems? Yes, like EA barmaids (though if they're to be fixed, I expect the mediators will be too, which would equal more work and delays on other, more interesting material like ship fusions). Let's give OGP a chance, hm? As for nerfs and whatever... heh. Online games are like that. Adapt, and continue, or quit, and play somewhere else. I choose to play UWO because I enjoy the adventure aspect. No more, no less.
